caseNameFull: Palermo v. Ganey, U. S. District Judge
attorneys: Frederick Bernays Wiener and Jacob Kossman for petitioner. Solicitor General Perlman for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The order of the Court of Appeals is vacated and the case is remanded to that court with directions to dismiss the proceeding upon the ground that the cause is moot.
